summary: 21-year-old Dallas LeBeau of Black Hawk killed attempting a road-gap ski jump over US Highway 40 at Berthoud Pass; group built a jump to film the stunt for a GoPro contest entry; he lacked the speed/distance and landed on the highway pavement near Mile Post 241.5 just west of the summit; 911 ~3 p.m.; unconscious and not breathing with bystander CPR underway; crews arrived 3:43 and could only pronounce him dead; helmeted, Grand County Coroner notified; pass closed alternating traffic ~3 hrs
location: Berthoud Pass (US Hwy 40, Mile Post 241.5, just west of summit)
notes: SnowBrains account of GCSO press release (opened run 137). Date pinned: 2024-04-09 was a Tuesday ('died on Tuesday', 911 'April 9 around 3 p.m.').
